name: PCC referral
job: PCC QR referral flow. Enrolls on utm_source=pcc_qr and adds the live pcc-referral tag, then re-enters WF-01.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Contact Created (utm_source=pcc_qr)
named_steps.comment: Sole enroll. Must not fire on other utm_source values.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: pcc-referral (live tag)
named_steps.comment: Live tag. Must not rename pcc-referral.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: contact.referral_channel = pcc_qr
named_steps.comment: Native field write. Must not touch location_* fields (WF-01 owns).

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Re-enter WF-01 Lead Capture
named_steps.comment: Contact then goes through normal Lead Capture. Must not create a Sales opp here.
